author: BBC Earth
description:
200 million porcelain crabs, one extraordinary underwater spectacle!
 
In one of the largest crab gatherings ever recorded, millions of porcelain crabs form astonishingly orderly lines, working together to feast on plankton. But how do these tiny creatures coordinate on such an enormous scale? The answer remains a mystery.
 
Witness this remarkable underwater phenomenon, captured on camera for the very first time in Blue Planet III.
 
Blue Planet III returns to uncover extraordinary new stories and lives hidden beneath our oceans. Find out where to watch the full series 👉 https://www.bbcearth.com/shows/blue-planet-iii
